remarks: Welcome to this stunning 2BR, 2Bath Condo. Situated in a prime location, this home features an open-concept living space that's perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Natural light presented by large windows that lead you to your private balcony where you can enjoy sunset views over the Norwalk River or watch the Norwalk River Rowing Club practice up and down the waterway. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, creating an ideal setting for entertaining or enjoying a quiet evening at home. A large primary suite features an en-suite bathroom and walk in closet with ample space. The generous sized second bedroom is perfect for guests, a home office, or a nursery. Located just .8 miles from the East Norwalk Train Station makes this spot a commuters dream. You're also within walking distance to the historic South Norwalk (SONO) district, where you'll find a variety of dining, shopping, and nightlife options, including the SONO Collection Mall. The community room also located on the second floor allows you the ability to host small gatherings. No stairs or steps as an elevator in the building gives you access to the covered private parking garage. This condo is a perfect combination of river views, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location, making it the perfect place to make home.
